title: Designing a Circadian Entrainment & Melatonin Shift Protocol
description: Construct an evidence-based circadian phase-shifting protocol for an international traveler crossing multiple time zones.
problemStatement:
An Olympic athlete is flying from New York (EST) to Paris (CET), crossing 6 time zones eastward. Unmitigated jet lag will severely degrade reaction times and peak athletic performance.

### Your Mission:
1. **Phase Response Curve (PRC)**: Using the human circadian Phase Response Curve, explain how timed morning bright light exposure (advance zone) shifts the SCN clock earlier, while evening light (delay zone) shifts it later.
2. **Melatonin Timing**: Specify the exact timing for low-dose exogenous melatonin administration in Paris to accelerate circadian phase advance without causing daytime grogginess.
3. **Zeitgeber Triad**: Outline a three-part synchronization strategy incorporating light exposure/darkness, exercise timing, and meal scheduling to entrain peripheral clocks in the liver and muscles.
hints: Hint 1: Traveling east requires phase advancing the circadian clock (making it think it is later than it is).
Hint 2: Morning outdoor sunlight suppresses melatonin and stimulates cortisol, while evening meal timing resets peripheral metabolic oscillators.
